info.name: CoinGecko Crypto Market Data Asset Platforms Tokens API
Get token data by contract address

params.name: network
params.description: The blockchain network identifier (e.g., eth, bsc, polygon_pos, solana, arbitrum, avalanche, base)

items.docs: Get detailed data for a specific token by its contract address on a given network. Includes price, volume, market cap, and other token metrics.

params.name: network
params.description: The blockchain network identifier (e.g., eth, bsc, polygon_pos, solana, arbitrum, avalanche, base)

params.name: addresses
params.description: Comma-separated list of token contract addresses (up to 30)

items.docs: Get price and market data for multiple tokens in a single request by providing a comma-separated list of token contract addresses on a specific network.

info.name: Get top pools for a token

params.name: network
params.description: The blockchain network identifier (e.g., eth, bsc, polygon_pos, solana, arbitrum, avalanche, base)

params.name: include
params.description: Additional data to include (e.g., base_token, quote_token, dex)

items.docs: Get the top liquidity pools that include a specific token on a given network, useful for finding trading venues for a token.

info.name: Get token info by contract address

params.name: network
params.description: The blockchain network identifier (e.g., eth, bsc, polygon_pos, solana, arbitrum, avalanche, base)

items.docs: Get metadata and descriptive information for a specific token by its contract address on a given network. Includes name, symbol, description, image, and website links.

info.name: Get pools for a specific token

params.name: network
params.description: The blockchain network identifier (e.g., eth, bsc, polygon_pos, solana, arbitrum, avalanche, base)

params.name: include
params.description: Additional data to include (e.g., base_token, quote_token, dex)

items.docs: Get all liquidity pools that contain a specific token on a given network. Results include pool metrics like volume, liquidity, and price data.
